title: Senior Research Scientists, Research Scientists, and Postdoctoral Researchers (26-1583)
institution: RIKEN Center for Interdisciplinary Theoretical and Mathematical Sciences (iTHEMS)
field: Theoretical physics in a broad sense and related fields
about: RIKEN iTHEMS (Division of Fundamental Mathematical Science) in Wako, Japan, is recruiting Senior Research Scientists, Research Scientists and Postdoctoral Researchers in theoretical physics and related fields under reference 26-1583. The application deadline is 18 December 2026.
requirements: Researchers who can advance theoretical physics in a broad sense and related fields and are familiar with iTHEMS's interdisciplinary approach across mathematics, physics and biology

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: requirement "Researchers who can advance theoretical physics in a broad sense and related fields" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

requirement "familiar with iTHEMS's interdisciplinary approach across mathematics, physics and biology" → objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Note: the catalog has no physics course; the match covers cross-disciplinary research workflow skills only.
